title: Accounting and Tax Services for Used-Car Dealerships

rows.before: We incorporated the dealership under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the inventory, equipment and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, separated F&I reserve and warranty revenue into their own accounts, and set a salary-and-dividend mix so surplus could stay in the company and defer tax.
rows.after: We incorporated the dealership under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the inventory, equipment and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), separated F&I reserve and warranty revenue into their own accounts, and set a salary-and-dividend mix so surplus could stay in the company and defer tax.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 12.2% rate
rows.after: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 11.2% rate
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

page_note: One '$600,000' occurrence refers to inventory rotated on a dealer lot (floor-plan example), not the small business limit; not R7, left as is. No JSON-LD or meta occurrences.
